svg.title: Simon Oakes - the journey so far
svg.desc: The journey so far: ten roles across ISPs, telecoms, media and platform engineering, from 2000 to now, as stops on one route over the Earth. ISP and telecoms foundations from 2000; automation, networks and build platforms from 2011; platforms, automation and AI infrastructure from 2024.
svg.text: Ten roles across ISPs, telecoms, media and platform engineering, from 2000 to now.
